name: Wholesale
blurb: Many retailer accounts in one place
intro: If you sell to retailers on credit, you have many accounts to follow. BolCash helps you see what each retailer owes you.

uses.title: Retailer accounts
uses.body: Keep the udhar of each retailer in one place.

uses.title: Payments from buyers
uses.body: Record each payment against the right account.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your own suppliers, and note it when you pay.
